portal-heading.purpose: Weekly Plan, Connect and Profile page titles below 640px; scoped extension of the existing serif hierarchy.

portal-heading-wide.purpose: Weekly Plan, Connect and Profile page titles from 640px.

public-display.purpose: Landing headline above 640px; the two-line composition and image inset are scoped to the public landing.

public-display-mobile.purpose: Landing headline at 640px and below, with a further 12.4vw adjustment below 360px.

public-section-heading.purpose: The short story and closing action sections; mobile uses clamp(2.7rem, 11vw, 4rem).

public-login-heading.purpose: Login display/photo column; at 640px and below it uses clamp(3rem, 13vw, 4.75rem).

public-action-label.purpose: Shared pill actions, including the single Google sign-in action.

shadows.name: portal-elevation
shadows.purpose: Scoped Connect provider and Profile editor surfaces; preserves unrelated global elevation.

motion.name: portal-state-transition
motion.purpose: Connect and Profile controls; removed under prefers-reduced-motion. Navigation uses 160ms color/background transitions and the shell uses 160ms opacity with 4px translation, disabled with useReducedMotion.

motion.name: public-ease
motion.purpose: Public reveal, photo settle and action feedback easing; no global easing change.

motion.name: public-section-reveal
motion.purpose: Visible section content settles once at viewport amount 0.12; delayed paired elements use 80ms. Reduced motion starts at the final state.

motion.name: public-photo-settle
motion.purpose: Atmospheric running windows; reduced motion removes scaling.

motion.name: public-week-selection
motion.purpose: Shared-layout selected-day fill. Reduced motion removes the layoutId and layout travel.

motion.name: public-session-change
motion.purpose: Selected example-session details; reduced motion starts at the final state.

motion.name: public-control-feedback
motion.purpose: Public action feedback. Opacity and day color use 180ms ease; reduced-motion CSS removes transitions.

motion.name: public-pending-spinner
motion.purpose: OAuth/session-check pending feedback only. Reduced-motion CSS disables spinning while labels and status stay visible.

breakpoints.name: public-narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width: 12px gutter, 12.4vw hero and four-column weekday strip.

breakpoints.name: public-mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width: 84px masthead; stack public intro, story, closing section and login; compact image inset, weekday strip and session detail.

breakpoints.name: public-compact
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width: session details use two columns with full-width note; story/login column gaps tighten.

publicGeometry.weekdayStrip: 7 equal columns with 5px gaps; 3px gaps at max-width:640px; 4 columns at max-width:359px
publicGeometry.sessionDetail: 3 columns:1fr 0.85fr 1.5fr; 2 columns at max-width:900px with note across both
publicGeometry.story: 2 columns:1.1fr 1fr; heading sticky at top:3rem; one column and static heading at max-width:640px
publicGeometry.login: 2 columns:1.2fr 0.9fr; equal columns at max-width:900px; stacked at max-width:640px; form max-width:28rem above 640px
publicGeometry.focus: 2px solid foreground; outline-offset:5px; currentColor on the action-color field
publicGeometry.photography: 480w/960w WebP derivatives of the existing hero-running.jpg; original provenance unknown; src/assets/public/README.md records derivation

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Existing Button's default variant; inherits the theme's CSS variables.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:40px; padding:8px 16px; background:hsl(var(--primary)); color:hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); border:0; border-radius:calc(var(--radius) - 2px); font-family:"DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; line-height:20px; transition:background-color 0.15s; } .ds-button:hover { background:hsl(var(--primary) / 0.9); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--ring)); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-button:disabled { pointer-events:none; opacity:0.5; }

components.name: Portal Profile Field
components.description: Scoped Profile field: 48px minimum height, 12px corners and foreground-derived control border. The portal-local override leaves the base Input unchanged.
components.css: .ds-portal-input { min-height:48px; width:100%; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid hsl(var(--foreground) / 0.45); border-radius:12px; background:hsl(var(--background)); color:hsl(var(--foreground)); font-family:"DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:16px; transition:background-color 160ms,border-color 160ms,color 160ms,box-shadow 160ms; } .ds-portal-input::placeholder { color:hsl(var(--foreground) / 0.7); opacity:1; } .ds-portal-input:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color:hsl(var(--foreground)); } .ds-portal-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--portal-primary, hsl(var(--primary))); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-portal-input:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:0.5; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-portal-input { transition:none; } }

components.name: Public Primary Action
components.description: Landing and Login pill action, with theme-local contrast fills and visible keyboard focus.
components.html: <button class="ds-public-action">Get started <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 17 17 7M7 7h10v10"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-public-action { --ds-action:hsl(var(--primary)); display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:2.25rem; min-height:56px; padding:0.875rem 1.5rem; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:var(--ds-action); color:hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); font-family:"DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:500; text-decoration:none; transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1),opacity 180ms ease; } :host-context(.theme-dark) .ds-public-action { --ds-action:color-mix(in srgb,hsl(var(--primary)),black 40%); } :host-context(.theme-bright) .ds-public-action { --ds-action:color-mix(in srgb,hsl(var(--primary)),black 30%); } .ds-public-action svg { width:20px; height:20px; transition:transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-public-action:hover svg { transform:translate(2px,-2px); } .ds-public-action:active { transform:scale(0.98); } .ds-public-action:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--foreground)); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-public-action:disabled { cursor:wait; opacity:0.65; } @media(max-width:640px) { .ds-public-action { min-height:54px; } } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-public-action,.ds-public-action svg { transition:none; } }

components.name: Public Example Day
components.description: Pressed weekday in the illustrative seven-day plan; the full page links this selection to live session details.
components.css: .ds-public-day { --ds-action:hsl(var(--primary)); position:relative; text-align:left; padding:1.125rem 1rem 0.75rem; min-height:128px; border:0; border-radius:0; background:hsl(var(--secondary)); color:hsl(var(--foreground)); font-family:"DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif; transition:color 180ms ease; } :host-context(.theme-dark) .ds-public-day { --ds-action:color-mix(in srgb,hsl(var(--primary)),black 40%); } :host-context(.theme-bright) .ds-public-day { --ds-action:color-mix(in srgb,hsl(var(--primary)),black 30%); } .ds-public-day[aria-pressed="true"] { background:var(--ds-action); color:hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); } .ds-public-day:not([aria-pressed="true"]):hover { color:var(--ds-action); } .ds-public-day:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--foreground)); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-public-day-name { display:block; font-size:0.875rem; } .ds-public-day-session { display:block; font-family:"DM Serif Display",Georgia,serif; font-size:clamp(1.125rem,1.8vw,1.625rem); margin-top:0.35rem; } .ds-public-day-mark { display:block; font-size:0.875rem; line-height:1; margin-top:0.75rem; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } @media(max-width:640px) { .ds-public-day { min-height:83px; padding:0.75rem 0.125rem; text-align:center; } .ds-public-day-session { display:none; } .ds-public-day-name { font-size:0.8125rem; } .ds-public-day-mark { margin-top:0.875rem; font-size:0.9375rem; } } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-public-day { transition:none; } }

components.name: Public Masthead
components.description: Normal-flow public brand and navigation; full implementation adds the theme selector and contextual home/story links.
components.html: Running CoachLog in
components.css: .ds-public-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:1rem; min-height:104px; color:hsl(var(--foreground)); background:hsl(var(--background)); font-family:"DM Sans",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:0.9375rem; } .ds-public-nav a { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; color:inherit; text-decoration:none; text-underline-offset:0.25em; } .ds-public-nav a:hover { text-decoration:underline; } .ds-public-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--foreground)); outline-offset:5px; } .ds-public-brand { font-family:"DM Serif Display",Georgia,serif; font-size:1.375rem; letter-spacing:-0.025em; } @media(max-width:640px) { .ds-public-nav { min-height:84px; font-size:0.8125rem; } .ds-public-brand { font-size:1.0625rem; } } .ds-public-brand { gap:0.65rem; } .ds-public-brand svg { width:32px; height:32px; flex:none; color:hsl(var(--primary)); } @media(max-width:640px) { .ds-public-brand { gap:0.375rem; } .ds-public-brand svg { width:26px; height:26px; } } :host-context(.theme-dark) .ds-public-brand svg { color:color-mix(in srgb,hsl(var(--primary)),black 40%); } :host-context(.theme-bright) .ds-public-brand svg { color:color-mix(in srgb,hsl(var(--primary)),black 30%); }

narrative.overview: Descriptive record of the existing React/Tailwind system. Code remains the visual authority under AGENTS.md. The scoped public extension shares the portal fonts and four palettes while introducing large editorial type, photographic windows, an interactive example week and a broad action-color field; it does not replace portal, onboarding or privacy composition.
keyCharacteristics: Serif headings and sans-serif body text
Photographic landing page; portal focused on sessions
Public Landing/Login: flat color fields, square photographic windows and pill actions
dos: Follow AGENTS.md and compare structural work with the agreed design or brief.
Do keep public composition and action overrides scoped to Landing and Login; preserve shared fonts, theme switching and the separate privacy/portal systems.
Do retain visible final content under reduced motion and distinguish an illustrative week from an athlete's actual plan.
donts: Confuse a code capture with an audit or redesign.
